text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah!!
Are all these fan letters on the desk for me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's eyes lit up at the large pile
of fan letters addressed to her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!
This is all thanks to your daily
guidance, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After bowing deeply,
Bamboo Memory opened the fan letter
and began reading its contents.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see here—
'Your passionate, powerful running
always gets my heart racing!'"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This one says—
"That serious showdown the other day was incredible!
I've never had a race get my heart pumping so much."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm honored to hear you say that!
The next letter is—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing your cheerful greetings at the school gate always fills me with energy!
I'll keep cheering you on!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm??
In front of the school gate? Greetings?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... fan mail for me
as the Disciplinary Committee Head!?
choice_data_list: You always work so hard, huh.
You always work so hard, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, no,
I'm just doing what's expected of me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
To protect this academy so students attending Tracen can learn
in good health and chase their dreams!
That's what being Disciplinary Committee Chairman is all about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"So, it's not like I'm doing these activities
just to get someone's approval.
I'm really not, but—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hearing warm words like that
really makes ya happy after all.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best with both public morals and racing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to live up to the expectations of both racing fans and Disciplinary Committee Chair fans alike!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Please keep whipping me into shape from here on out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's declaration of resolve
echoed loudly through the air.
